The representative inserts two missing groups of five at the beginning. Every223 contiguous-gap and24976 ordered two-group placement is compared.
The full retrospective candidate uniquely minimizes ordinary-coordinate changes at the prefix; masking its opening, INTERNIERUNG and KARPATHEN leaves five tied two-group fits.
No independent duplicate or original German plaintext verifies the proposed missing prefix.
